Decipher printed rarity as a letter plus an optional number (how many versions of that common/uncommon/rare were in the set).

== Common ==
* '''C''' / '''C1''' / '''C2''' / '''C3''' — Common. Higher numbers usually meant more copies in the print run.

== Uncommon ==
* '''U''' / '''U1''' / '''U2''' — Uncommon.

== Rare ==
* '''R''' / '''R1''' / '''R2''' — Rare.

== Other ==
* '''F''' — Fixed (starter-deck only in some products, notably Special Edition).
* '''PM''' / '''PV''' — Premium / preview.
* '''UR''' — Ultra-Rare (Death Star II).
* '''XR''' — Exclusive Rare (Death Star II starter decks: Admiral Ackbar, Admiral Piett).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Decipher Complete Card List] (archive) key to rarity.
